architecture.backbone: ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 (4-channel conv1, 512-D features per frame)
architecture.temporal_module: 1D TCN (2 Conv1d blocks, GELU, BatchNorm1d, Dropout=0.2, AdaptiveAvgPool1d, Linear head)

temporal_sampling_rule: Deterministic: T=8 approximately evenly spaced frames selected across [start_frame, end_frame]. CVB preserves target tracklet identity using authentic per-frame bboxes. Kaggle Beef samples directly from single-cow video clips.
test_set_protection: Canonical test.csv was not parsed, loaded into a DataFrame, sampled, used for tuning, or evaluated.
